people.role: Abbess of Lê Hoa Am since 1020; keeper of the seal on Hoắc Hàn Quang's cave
people.appearance: A small, straight old woman with a shaved head under a white hood, whose hands are always cold and whose voice is always warm.
people.backstory: Thái Lê Tuyết was born in Hòe Âm in 760, the same spring as her playmate Tiết Hàn Mai (tiet_han_mai), and the two girls sat under the Tiêu family's locust trees and argued about which of them the ice would take. The Pavilion took Tiết. The nuns took Thái, at eleven, when the second abbess Liêu Thanh Nhu (lieu_thanh_nhu) found her sitting in the snow at the Gate Hermitage. She became abbess in 1020 (A109) and has kept the hermitage for 180 years by the founder's two rules: pray for the dead under the ice, and let no one who seeks the sword pass the gate. In 1150 the Tiêu clan sent its first son to that gate (A110). The hermitage remembers that she turned him away because he was a boy. In fact the twelve-year-old Tiêu Vấn Phong (tieu_van_phong) asked her, before he asked anything else, where the cold light on the mountain was. In 1152 she walked to the seal with her prioress Mạnh Tĩnh Chi (manh_tinh_chi) and sat against it for a season. The next walk falls in 1202, and she does not expect to live much past it. Since Chúc Long Sơn rumbled in 1199 (A111) she has rung the bell every night.
people.wants: To choose the right nun to walk to the seal with her in 1202, and to teach her the Sutra before she dies.
people.secret: The founder's vow forbids the sword, not men. She let the hermitage believe she turned the Tiêu boy away for his sex, and she has never told him why.

people.role: Prioress of the Gate Hermitage (the old seat) and captain of its law; the only other living person who has seen the seal
people.appearance: Tall and grey-robed, with a face like a closed door and a pear-wood sword she has drawn eleven times in two hundred years.
people.backstory: Mạnh Tĩnh Chi was left on the step of the Gate Hermitage as a newborn in the winter of 980, wrapped in a miner's coat, and the grey sisters raised her. She has never lived anywhere but the gate. She took the white robe at forty when Ice woke in her on the glacier, studied under the second abbess Liêu Thanh Nhu (lieu_thanh_nhu), and has been prioress of the gate since Thái Lê Tuyết (thai_le_tuyet) became abbess in 1020. Every man who has come up the mountain since then has met her first, and none has passed. She copies the founder's vow each morning in her own hand and believes every word of the version she was taught. In 1152 she walked with Thái to the seal and sat beside her against it for a season. She heard something behind it that Thái did not. She expects to walk again in 1202 and to be abbess after it, and she cannot understand why Thái hesitates.
people.wants: To walk to the seal in 1202 and to be named abbess after Thái.
people.secret: Since 1152 she has dreamed of the sword behind the seal every winter, and it speaks to her in a man's voice. The keeper of the gate is the one who wants to open it.

people.backstory: A jade-cutter's daughter from the Cold Jade Mine, where Ice woke in her at nine in the deepest shaft. Thái Lê Tuyết (thai_le_tuyet) took her as her last true disciple and gave her the bell cast from the frozen bolt (A105). She has rung it every night since the mountain rumbled (A111). Thái means to take her to the seal in 1202. Ứng does not know this, and Mạnh Tĩnh Chi (manh_tinh_chi) does.

people.appearance: Broad in the shoulder, sunburnt from standing in the gate's glare, with a miner's short grey sword.
people.backstory: A silver-miner's daughter who will never wear the white: her root has no Water deep enough for Ice. She has made the grey robe a trade instead, and leads the twenty sisters who hold the Gate Hermitage under Mạnh Tĩnh Chi (manh_tinh_chi). Thirty years ago she turned a hunter of Tầm Kiếm Đường, Tịch Lang Tung (tich_lang_tung), away from the gate. He comes back every spring with a basket of larch mushrooms, and she takes the basket.

people.role: Founder of Lê Hoa Am (600); last disciple of Hoắc Hàn Quang; sealed his cave in 702
people.backstory: The last disciple of the wandering ice swordsman Hoắc Hàn Quang (hoac_han_quang), sent away before his tribulation. She came back to the foot of his mountain on the night in 600 when snow fell like pear blossom (A103) and opened a hermitage for the widows of the ice villages. In 700 his tribulation failed in the north (C014, C039). In 702 she cut the frozen lightning, cast the bell, sealed his empty cave with his sword inside, and wrote the vow: let no one who seeks the sword pass this gate.

people.backstory: The founder Kỷ Hoa Ảnh's (ky_hoa_anh) disciple and the hermitage's abbess for 230 years. She walked to the seal four times, made the women-only custom of the gate into a rule because the men who came up the mountain all asked about the sword, and found Thái Lê Tuyết (thai_le_tuyet) sitting in the snow at the gate in 771.
